data.title: Delivery robot service expanded in Alexandria to Wonder food hall | ALXnow
data.description: The deployment of autonomous sidewalk delivery robots is expanding further in Alexandria. Serve Robotics announced today (Monday) that the Wonder food hall at 3615 Richmond Highway will offer robot deliveries.
